name: Hindi
tagline: Chat with family, haggle in the bazaar, travel India with confidence.

items.prompt: Someone asks 'आप कैसे हैं?' You reply:

items.example: माफ़ कीजिए, आपका नाम क्या है?
items.exampleMeaning: Excuse me, what is your name?

items.text: माफ़ कीजिए, आपका नाम क्या है?
items.answer: Excuse me, what is your name?

items.prompt: How do you say 'see you again'?

units.title: Basics 2
units.goal: Talk about people and where they are from

units.title: Numbers
units.goal: Count, say your age and phone number

items.text: मेरा फ़ोन नंबर नौ, आठ, तीन, एक है।
items.meaning: My phone number is nine, eight, three, one.

units.title: Food
units.goal: Order food and drinks and say what you like

items.prompt: How do you say 'I like tea'?

items.text: एक चाय और दो रोटी, कृपया।
items.meaning: One tea and two rotis, please.

units.title: Family
units.goal: Talk about your family and where you live

items.text: मेरी छोटी बहन दस साल की है।
items.meaning: My younger sister is ten years old.

items.sentence: मेरा ___ भाई बीस साल का है।
items.meaning: My elder brother is twenty years old.
My elder sister is a teacher.

items.example: मेरा बेटा पाँच साल का है।
items.exampleMeaning: My son is five years old.

items.text: मेरा बेटा पाँच साल का है।
items.meaning: My son is five years old.

items.text: मेरा परिवार दिल्ली में रहता है।
मेरी माँ और पिता घर में हैं।
items.answer: My mother and father are at home.

items.text: मेरा परिवार भारत में रहता है।
मेरे दो बेटे और एक बेटी हैं।
items.meaning: I have two sons and one daughter.

units.title: Directions
units.goal: Ask where places are and follow directions

items.exampleMeaning: The school is near the house.
The hotel is near the station.

items.meaning: The hospital is near the station.
The school is near the house.

items.exampleMeaning: The bank is opposite the hotel.
The school is behind the market.
I have to go to the station.

items.text: I have to go to the market.

items.meaning: The bank is opposite the hotel.

items.answer: Excuse me, where is the hospital?

items.meaning: I have to go to the station.

options: The school is near the market.
The school is behind the market.
The market is behind the school.

items.meaning: The station is far from here.
Go left, the bank is there.

units.title: Time
units.goal: Tell the time and talk about days

items.answer: today at eight in the morning

items.text: रविवार को मैं घर में हूँ।
items.answer: On Sunday I am at home.

items.meaning: today at six in the evening
There are seven days in a week.

items.answer: tomorrow at ten in the morning at the station

items.text: सोमवार को सुबह आठ बजे स्कूल
items.meaning: school on Monday at eight in the morning
We'll meet at six in the evening.

units.title: Shopping
units.goal: Ask prices, bargain and describe things by colour

items.exampleMeaning: The shop is in the market.

items.answer: I want to take this shirt.
How much are the white shoes?

items.sentence: यह बहुत ___ है, थोड़ा कम कीजिए।
items.meaning: This is very expensive, please reduce a little.

items.text: लाल कमीज़ सौ रुपये की है।
items.meaning: The red shirt is one hundred rupees.

items.exampleMeaning: I get up in the morning.
I get up at six o'clock.
I get up at seven o'clock.

items.text: I get up at six o'clock.

items.meaning: I get up at seven in the morning (f.).

items.text: मेरा भाई दोपहर में काम करता है।
items.answer: My brother works in the afternoon.

items.exampleMeaning: The children play in the evening.

items.answer: मैं रात को टीवी देखता हूँ।

items.meaning: The children play in the evening.

items.sentence: मैं रात को दस बजे ___ हूँ।
items.meaning: I sleep at ten at night (m.).

items.text: मेरी बहन रोज़ टीवी देखती है।
items.answer: My sister watches TV every day.

items.meaning: I get up early every day.

items.text: मेरे पिता सुबह छह बजे उठते हैं।
items.answer: My father gets up at six in the morning.

items.text: बच्चे रात को जल्दी सोते हैं।
items.meaning: The children sleep early at night.

units.title: Past, Future & Opinions
units.goal: Talk about yesterday, tomorrow and what you think

items.meaning: Yesterday I went to the market.

items.text: कल मेरे दोस्त घर में थे।
items.answer: Yesterday my friends were at home.

items.exampleMeaning: Tomorrow I will go to Delhi.
I will go to the market.

items.text: Tomorrow I will go to Delhi.

items.meaning: I will go to the market in the evening (f.).

items.answer: Maybe I will go to school tomorrow.

items.example: मुझे लगता है यह अच्छा है।

items.answer: मुझे लगता है यह अच्छा है।

items.sentence: तुम क्यों नहीं खाते? ___ मुझे भूख नहीं है।
items.meaning: Why don't you eat? Because I am not hungry.

items.text: मुझे लगता है यह सच नहीं है।
items.answer: I think this is not true.

items.text: कल बाज़ार में बहुत मज़ा आया।
items.meaning: Yesterday at the market it was great fun.

items.sentence: यह बहुत ___ है, क्योंकि कल परीक्षा है।
items.meaning: This is very important, because tomorrow is the exam.

items.text: मुझे लगता है कल मैं घर में रहूँगा।
items.answer: I think tomorrow I will stay at home.

items.text: मुझे लगता है यह सच है।
चाय अच्छी थी, लेकिन खाना बुरा था।
items.meaning: The tea was good, but the food was bad.
